channel.title: The Tidy Routine
channel.description: Simple cleaning and organizing routines for busy homes

item.title: How to Make a Christmas Budget You'll Actually Stick To
item.description: A simple step-by-step Christmas budget - how to set one total, split it across gifts, food, decorations and travel, and track spending so January stays stress-free.

item.title: How to Organize Desk Cables - A 30-Minute Fix for Good
item.description: A simple step-by-step way to organize the cables on and under your desk - what to unplug, how to route and label cords, and which small helpers actually make it stick.

item.title: How to Get Organized for Christmas - A Simple 8-Week Plan
item.description: A week-by-week plan to get organized for Christmas - gifts, cards, food, decorations and cleaning - so everything is done early and December stays calm.

item.title: How to Organize Paperwork at Home - A Simple Filing System
item.description: A simple system for organizing paperwork at home - one inbox, a small set of hanging folders, what to keep and what to shred - so the paper pile never comes back.

item.title: 12 Practical Gift Ideas for People Who Love an Organized Home
item.description: Useful, well-chosen gift ideas for the person who loves a tidy home - from label makers and drawer organizers to cozy reset tools - plus how to pick the right one.

item.title: The Thanksgiving Hosting Checklist - A Calm 2-Week Countdown
item.description: A day-by-day Thanksgiving hosting checklist - menu, shopping, table, guest prep and a simple cooking timeline - so the big day feels calm instead of chaotic.

item.title: The Holiday Cleaning Checklist - Get Guest-Ready in 4 Weeks
item.description: A 4-week holiday cleaning checklist that gets your home guest-ready without a last-minute panic - what to clean each week, guest room prep, and the 30-minute pre-arrival reset.

item.title: The New Year Home Reset - A 4-Week Plan for a Fresh Start
item.description: Start the year with a calmer home - a realistic 4-week New Year home reset plan covering decluttering, deep cleaning and simple routines you'll actually keep.

item.title: A Simple Weekly Cleaning Schedule for Busy People (Free Printable)
item.description: A realistic weekly cleaning schedule that takes about 20 minutes a day - one focus per day, so the whole home stays clean without a weekend marathon. Free printable included.

item.title: The 15-Minute Evening Reset That Keeps Your Home Tidy
item.description: A simple 15-minute evening routine that resets your kitchen, living room and entry every night - so you wake up to a calm, tidy home. Step-by-step checklist inside.

item.title: 10 Laundry Room Organization Ideas for Small Spaces
item.description: Laundry room organization ideas for small spaces and laundry closets - shelves above the machine, rolling carts, sorting hampers and a simple routine to stop the laundry pile.

item.title: Pantry Organization Ideas That Save Money (and Space)
item.description: Pantry organization ideas for small pantries and cabinets - zones, clear containers, risers and a first-in-first-out system that stops you buying what you already have.

item.title: The 30-Day Declutter Challenge (One Small Task a Day)
item.description: Declutter your whole home in 30 days with one small task a day - kitchen, bathroom, closet, paperwork and more. Day-by-day list plus tips for what to do with everything you let go.

item.title: Small Entryway Organization - 9 Ideas for a Clutter-Free Front Door
item.description: Small entryway organization ideas - shoe storage, wall hooks, key and mail stations and a drop zone - so the first thing you see when you come home is calm, not chaos.

item.title: How to Clean a Bathroom in 15 Minutes (Step by Step)
item.description: A fast, step-by-step bathroom cleaning routine that takes 15 minutes - the right order, what to use, and the daily habits that keep it clean between weekly cleans.

item.title: How to Declutter Your Clothes - 7 Questions That Make It Easy
item.description: How to declutter your wardrobe without regret - seven simple questions for every item, the hanger trick, and what to do with the clothes you let go.

item.title: 12 Small Kitchen Organization Ideas That Actually Add Space
item.description: Practical small kitchen organization ideas - vertical storage, cabinet risers, under-shelf baskets and more - to double the usable space in a tiny kitchen without renovating.

item.title: Toy Organization Ideas That Kids Can Actually Keep Up With
item.description: Simple toy organization ideas that work for real families - fewer toys out, picture labels, open bins and a toy rotation system kids can manage themselves.

item.title: Under-Sink Organization - How to Fix the Messiest Cabinet in Your Kitchen
item.description: Step-by-step under-sink organization - how to work around the pipes, which organizers fit, and how to keep cleaning supplies tidy and leak-proof.

item.title: How to Organize Your Fridge (and Waste Less Food)
item.description: A simple fridge organization system - what goes on each shelf, which bins help, and the weekly habit that stops food going bad at the back.

item.title: 10 Small Bathroom Storage Ideas for Tiny Spaces
item.description: Small bathroom storage ideas that make room without renovating - over-the-toilet shelves, shower caddies, drawer dividers and more for apartments and tiny bathrooms.

item.title: Closet Organization on a Budget - 9 Ideas Under $30
item.description: Budget closet organization ideas that double hanging space and make every outfit visible - slim hangers, shelf dividers, hanging organizers and the declutter rule that matters most.

item.title: 11 Vinegar and Baking Soda Cleaning Hacks (and When Not to Use Them)
item.description: Cheap, effective cleaning hacks with vinegar, baking soda and lemon - plus the surfaces you should never use vinegar on and the combinations to avoid.

item.title: The Monthly Deep Cleaning Checklist (One Area Per Week)
item.description: A monthly deep cleaning checklist split into four weekly sessions - kitchen, bathrooms, living spaces and whole-home jobs - so the deep clean never takes a whole weekend.
